description: This file contains unit tests for the OCIContainer component, including event handling, container lifecycle operations, and RPC interface testing using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests various container states, event notifications, and RPC methods such as start, stop, pause, resume, hibernate, wakeup, execute command, and annotations, both via JSONRPC and JSONRPC interface, with mock dependencies.
